::: {#def-homogeneous-network-interference .theorem}
## Homogeneous network interference

An exposure mapping exhibits homogeneous network interference with respect to a graph set $\mathcal{H}$ if it is separable with positionally invariant and bounded component functions with respect to $\mathcal{H}$. An NPSEM satisfies homogeneous network interference if all its exposure mappings do.
:::
